description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Schema::Component::Result::Boolify' that extends 'DBIx::Class::FilterColumn' to handle boolean columns by ensuring their values are stored as 1 or 0. It registers a filter for columns with data types matching 'bool' or 'boolean' and provides a method to convert values to boolean representation.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::Result::Boolify
classes.description: A class that extends DBIx::Class::FilterColumn to handle boolean column storage and conversion.

methods.name: register_column
methods.description: Registers a filter for boolean data types to ensure values are stored as 1 or 0.

methods.name: to_bool
methods.description: Converts a value to 1 if true, otherwise 0.
